text: Source reading opens the workbook as an electronic book. Word help explains unfamiliar terms. You can also select an underlined term in the teaching text to open its meaning. Tools and examples contains the working documents that you will learn to prepare, together with completed fictional examples. You do not need to download and import separate progress files.
